name: VayuPutra Hanuman
detailed_description:
A fractured realm.

Set in a dark, mythological version of ancient India, VayuPutra Hanuman is a third-person action-adventure that follows the journey of Lord Hanuman after the great war of Lanka. Years have passed, and the world has changed. Dharma crumbles, asuras rise again, and the gods have grown distant. Amidst this chaos, Lord Hanuman must rediscover his purpose and use his divine powers to bring the save the Dharma.


A Tale of Courage and Dharma

Awaken the Vanara Within

Unleash Lord Hanuman's powers as you master brutal melee combat, mace techniques, aerial movement, and god abilities tied to your divine heritage. Fight mythic beasts, ancient warriors, rakshasas, and dangerous asuras in cinematic encounters blending skill and strength.


A Living, Breathing World of Wonders and Chaos.

From whispering willows to scorched battlefields, explore a carefully, handcrafted world humming alive with secrets, side legends, NPCs, and challenges rooted from Indian folklore. Encounter cursed kings, corrupted rakshasa, and spirits that test your journey and shape your path.

Features:

  • Fluid, cinematic combat with combo-driven melee, parries, powers, and transformations.

  • Expansive semi-open world with interconnected zones filled with mythological lore.

  • Upgrade divine abilities, combat skills, unlock skill trees.

  • Boss battles against asuras, titans, and rakshasas, each with their own lore and combat style.

    Will you become the guardian of dharma once more or forge a new path as the world’s last hope?

short_description: Step into the role of divine warrior Lord Hanuman devotee of Lord Rama, and journey through ancient India, cursed kings, and demonic powers threaten the balance of the three realms. Armed with ancient powers, wield the strength of the Vanara, re-awaken dormant powers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4670k or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD RX 5500 XT (8GB) or Intel Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8600 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4090 (8GB) or AMD RX 5500 XT (8GB) or Intel Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 80 GB available space
